Hi everyone in Physlib,

I just posted an announcement in Project announcements about Quantum4Lean v0.8.0:

A new independent Lean 4 library for formally verified NISQ quantum computing. It includes:

  • Bit-exact statevector simulation + noise models
  • Formal Clifford circuit verification over ℤ[i] with tactics
  • Declarative circuit DSL
  • FFI to Metal 3 on Apple Silicon
  • Translators from Diophantine equations / polynomials → Ising Hamiltonians (for QAOA/VQE)
  • Quantum chemistry examples (exact H₂) and topology

Repo: https://github.com/Alektronnik/Quantum4Lean

It’s currently self-contained (no mathlib dependency). I’d be interested in any feedback, especially from people working on QuantumInfo / formal quantum chemistry.

Happy to discuss possible synergies.

Best regards,
Bezalel
This topic was moved here from #Project announcements > Quantum4Lean: Verified Quantum Computing + Hamiltonian trans by Kim Morrison.
